definitions.gloss: home-based care; home nursing care; at-home caregiving
definitions.explanation: Providing nursing or caregiving services to elderly or disabled individuals in their own home, rather than in a hospital or care facility. A major topic in Japan's aging society.

examples.japanese: {在宅介護|ざいたくかいご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: More families are choosing home-based care.

examples.japanese: {在宅介護|ざいたくかいご}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{負担|ふたん}→負担：09752_futan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧。
examples.english: Home-based care places a heavy burden on the family.

examples.japanese: {在宅介護|ざいたくかいご}サービス⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{利用|りよう}して→利用する：21735_riyousuru⟧、⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{自宅|じたく}→自宅：00129_jitaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{看|み}て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I'm looking after my mother at home using home care services.

notes: Composed of ⟦{在宅|ざいたく}→在宅：07696_zaitaku⟧ (at home) + ⟦{介護|かいご}→介護：04805_kaigo⟧ (nursing care). A key term in Japan's {高齢化社会|こうれいかしゃかい} (aging society) discussions. Common related terms: {在宅介護|ざいたくかいご}サービス (home care services), ⟦{訪問介護|ほうもんかいご}→訪問介護：24515_houmonkaigo⟧ (visiting care), {介護保険|かいごほけん} (long-term care insurance). Contrasts with {施設介護|しせつかいご} (institutional/facility care). The {介護保険|かいごほけん} system provides support for both types.
